# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment

The incumbent uses 328 LUTs, 54 FFs, no DSPs, and is already timing-feasible at WNS 0.108 ns and WHS 0.24 ns. The objective is therefore a strict LUT reduction, with DSPs available on the xc7a35tcpg236-1; no prior iteration results are provided. The top’s authoritative latency is known to be 2 cycles, so its annotation must remain `// @latency 2`.

## Hypothesis

Mapping the four unsigned 8×8 multipliers to DSP48s may reduce LUT use, at the cost of four DSP48s and possible routing or timing changes.

## Instruction for generator

Apply Vivado’s `USE_DSP` attribute to the four multiplier operations that produce `product0` through `product3`, keeping each product explicitly 16 bits and unsigned. Preserve the pair sums, final 18-bit sum, both elastic stages, handshake logic, reset behavior, and all top-level observable cycles. Keep the top latency annotation at `// @latency 2`; this candidate is an objective improvement only if it passes every gate and routed LUT usage is strictly below the incumbent’s 328.
